description.narrative: The prototype that this Project is going to build is to monitor the SDGs situation and achievements in Colombia. In this sense, filling the gap between Government´s actions and citizen´s lack of information. This Project aims to improve social dialogue (Swedish Cooperation Strategy in Colombia) through supporting digital tools where citizens can follow Colombia´s status about SDGs. Colombian Government is committed with public information due its chapter 2 about Anti-corruption strategies in the National Development Plan (2014 - 2018).

Insatsens mål är att skapa en prototyp som ämnar vara en första version av en användarvänlig webbplattform som är tänkt att göra aktuell information tillgänglig för allmänheten. Prototypen ligger inom ramen för Colombias nationella strategi (National utvecklings plan, 2014 - 2018), för att nå de hållbara utvecklingsmålen ( SDG) genom att främja transparens i regeringens arbete samt göra information rörande regeringens arbete med de hållbara utvecklingsmålen tillgänglig för allmänheten.

This contribution is aimed to create a prototype of a virtual platform that visualize the SDGs achievement of the Colombian Government. The institution in charge of it is the National Planning Department. Colombia is one of the countries in the forefront when it comes to SDGs, hence, this countries aso has international agreements to follow.

sector.narrative: Public sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative: Although there were some problems that resulted in minor delays on the achievement of the goals for this contribution, the final product was acquired. These problems where mainly with regards of IOM's administrative procedure hiring the web based developers (Data Act Lab); also, delays regarding communication and coordination due to time zone differences(Stockholm/Bogota). This later obstacle was mitigated by celebrating weekly meetings that allowed fluent and permanent communication amongst the teams. The final product was a functional web-based platform thata allows the monitor and follow-up of the achievement of 145 selected indicators that belong to the 17 Sustainable Development goals for Colombia.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
